criterion: Separate supervised alpha forecast from execution-fill probability and risk forecast; components each have independently calibrated targets and quality metrics.
test_result: 22 forecast-component and learned-model tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed; source and strategy-variant inventory checks passed (619 Python files, 253 source-linked candidates).
evidence_scope: Synthetic typed forecasts and synthetic validation observations. No real model calibration or market performance is represented.
operational_limits: Validation reports require a fixed model identity, target schema, matured target, and target revision timestamp.
Alpha, fill, and risk metrics use distinct target fields and are calculated independently.
Alpha, fill, and risk calibrators are separate and require untouched validation; no calibrator can authorize a trade.
